act_name: Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Act, 2018
heading: Short title and commencement
title: Short title and commencement
text:
1. Short title and commencement.⸻ (1) This Act may be called the Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall come into force on such date or dates and in such Federally Administered Tribal Areas or part thereof, as the Federal Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, determine from time to time.

act_name: Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Act, 2018
heading: Extension of jurisdiction of Supreme Court
title: Extension of jurisdiction of Supreme Court
text:
2.
Extension of jurisdiction of Supreme Court.⸻ The Supreme Court of Pakistan shall have, in relation to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas, the same jurisdiction as it has in relation to the province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
